scopes.tasksWriteDetail: Append-only: it can add, never replace what someone wrote. Also builds the tree — spaces, folders and lists — so a new project can be set up in one go.
scopes.tasksManageDetail: Move them between columns, and overwrite title, description or priority. Also corrects or withdraws comments you wrote — never anyone else's. Needed to mark work as done.
scopes.notesWriteDetail: Append-only: adds a new page, never touches one that already exists. What a migration from another notes app needs.
scopes.notesManageDetail: Overwrites a page's title or body outright — the note's own conflict/history safeguards still apply, but the content changes.
scopes.reportsWriteDetail: Append-only: add a comment or attach an image to a report.
scopes.reportsManageDetail: Change status, assignee, priority, category or area, remove a report's screenshots, and correct or withdraw comments <1>you</1> wrote — never anyone else's, which cac refuses outright.
scopes.collectionsWriteDetail: Leaves a described API ready to run. Creating only — editing, deleting and sharing one stay out of reach, sharing because it reaches other people.
scopes.docsWriteDetail: Append-only: adds to the end of a section and records decisions, and can never delete what somebody else wrote. Safe while a person has the document open.
scopes.docsManageDetail: Replaces a whole section and decides who a document belongs to. A save that arrives after somebody else's is refused rather than applied, but this is still the permission that can overwrite work. It cannot mark a document reviewed — that says a person confirmed it, and only a superadmin signs it.
